answer: Duplicate identities cost a fresh stake plus lost rewards, while honest agents recover theirs on the mesa ledger. Each epoch, agents must burn a small stake to post a signed beacon heartbeat from their registered device, and peers cross-check timing entropy against a velvet-sealed identity log. Sybils therefore pay real per-identity capital and forfeit it on detection, making mass fake accounts uneconomical. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
